meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把口播或访谈视频加上随字幕同步的图形卡片,原片画面保持不动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有口播或访谈素材,想加同步图形卡但不想动原画面。
copy.tagline_en: Add transcript-synced graphic cards to your talking-head video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have talking-head footage and want graphic cards fast

howto.what: 给已拍好的口播/访谈/播客视频叠加与转写时间同步的图形卡片(标题、下三分之一、数据标注、引用、侧栏、画中画等),原视频原样播放,可选 16:9/9:16/4:5 画布并渲染成 MP4。
howto.when: 当你说出“graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics”、“package / dress up my video”等关键词,想给已有视频加设计图形时触发;只做普通字幕或意图不明时,先去 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给这条口播视频加图形卡片,画布用竖屏 9:16
say.note: 会先确认输入视频,再设计并渲染卡片

say.text: 把这个访谈视频包装一下,加下三分之一标题和数据标注
say.note: 卡片内容按转写文本生成

say.text: 这条播客视频做成 4:5 画布,卡片跟字幕对齐
say.note: 落地时询问画幅、风格等参数

howto.what_en: Layers timed, designed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture) onto an existing talking-head/interview/podcast video, synced to the transcript; the clip plays untouched, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas, rendered to MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics" or to "package / dress up my video" and want designed graphics on an existing clip; for plain subtitles or unclear intent, go to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Add graphic overlay cards to this talking-head video, 9:16 portrait canvas
say_en.note: Confirms the input clip, then designs and renders cards

say_en.text: Package this interview video with lower-thirds and data callouts
say_en.note: Card content comes from the transcript

say_en.text: Make this podcast video 4:5 with cards aligned to the transcript
say_en.note: Aspect, style and card count are asked at build time
